As Fiserv (FISV) Share Price Declined, North Star Investment Management Has Boosted Holding by $917,320; Snow Capital Management LP Cut Its Position in Apple (AAPL) by $1.89 Million as Stock Price Rose
May 31, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
North Star Investment Management Corp increased its stake in Fiserv Inc (FISV) by 389.16% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. North Star Investment Management Corp bought 12,920 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.25% with the market. The institutional investor held 16,240 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.16 million, up from 3,320 at the end of the previous reported quarter. North Star Investment Management Corp who had been investing in Fiserv Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $29.73 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.21% or $0.15 during the last trading session, reaching $72.6. About 1.17M shares traded. Fiserv, Inc. (NASDAQ:FISV) has risen 15.27% since May 31, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 2.70% the S&P500.
Snow Capital Management Lp decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 54.65% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Snow Capital Management Lp sold 11,300 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 9,377 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.57M, down from 20,677 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Snow Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $918.49B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.34% or $0.63 during the last trading session, reaching $186.87. About 26.72 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since May 31, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
